steps.text: The Abyssal Zenith is located beneath the Challenger's Deep, with the entrance at -5375, -7390, 400; Similarly to other layers, the path below is locked until the player acquires the Anglers Lantern from the Abyssal Zenith.

Within this pond are three large Anglerfish, which will kill the player if they come into contact. Holding out an Orca or The Kraken will make the Anglerfish unable to kill the player. Feeding an Orca or Kraken is required to calm the Anglerfish and put them to sleep temporarily, allowing the player to interact with them and take the Anglers Lantern, which is required to descend further.

The player must enter the water while holding either an Orca or a Kraken and wait for the anglerfish to approach, then it must be fed to the anglerfish to cause it to go to sleep for five minutes, allowing the player to take the Anglers Lantern. It is recommended to take at least 2 Orcas/Krakens, using one to make an anglerfish sleep, and holding the other to avoid the player being eaten while collecting the lantern.
Additionally, if the player is at least Level 150, the Rod Of The Zenith can be purchased here (-13625, -11035, 355), for C$ 700,000.
Atlantis can be entered through the crevice within the Grand Reef central island at -3576, 148, 524.
Upon entering the crevice, the player will be teleported to the center area of Atlantis, where there will be an Inn Keeper and a portal back to Moosewood nearby.

Boreal Pines is a large snowy pine forest with many icicles protruding from the ground. Wooden cabins are also scattered around the island. The Boreal Pines can be accessed via a portal in the main map, and is located next to the Northern Expedition.

Being at the Boreal Pines causes the player to lose Warmth, unless the player has a Winter Cloak or Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 2/Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 3 equipped. Getting in contact with the water near the island also damages the player, dealing damage equal to 10% of their health.
Similar to the Northern Expedition, the Boreal Pines can only be reached by entering the large portal situated in the Southern region of the Ocean at -1750, 130, 3750.

Entering the portal will teleport the player to a few kilometers out from the Northern Summit at 18100, 130, 2700. A similar portal, labelled 'Exit Of The Expedition', can be found when travelling west from this location. Accordingly, entering this portal teleports the player back to the Ocean.
There are two main ways to access the Brine Pool:
Glider & Path
Exit the water at -1710, -235, -3075
Follow the short path up reaching the wall at the end
Use the Glider to wrap around the rock to the left and reach a platform
Wrap around the next rock using the Glider again to reach another platform
Climb the rocks to reach the cave entrance at -1725, -175, -3125
Glider & Pillar
Climb the central pillar to its highest point at -1600, -110, -2845
Glide Between North-east and North towards the rocks leading up to the cave entrance
Once at the cave entrance, the Brine Pool will be at the end of the long tunnel (-1795, -140, -3310)
The Brine-Infused Rod can be purchased on a high ledge to the right after entering the Brine Pool at -1731, -100, -3345. A skeleton wearing a hat can be found sitting next to it.

The Calm Zone is located beneath the Abyssal Zenith, and is the fourth layer at the very bottom of the caves, with the entrance at -4145, -11210, 1395; it is the final location of the Cave System and Submarine are not used past this point.
The Carrot Garden can be accessed through a hole near the Alligator Marsh, where unique fish can be caught, and the Carrot Rod can be purchased for C$ 45,000.

The Challenger's Deep is located beneath the Volcanic Vents, with the entrance at -2630, -3830, 755; Similarly to the Volcanic Vents, the player is forced to take a tunnel to the North-West to unlock the required equipment to travel further down.

Within this cave is a Submariner and an Inn Keeper, as well as the upgrade station to acquire the Ice Upgrade for the Submarine, which is required to progress past the Challenger's Deep. Additionally, a portal back to Roslit Bay can be found at -735, -3280, -725, allowing the player to exit the cave system.

An Ice Tunnel can be accessed through a cave to the North-West, which leads to a pool where the Cryoskin and Polar Prowler may be caught for the Ice Upgrade; as well as the rest of the fish required for the Challenger's Deep Bestiary. Additionally, the Challenger's Rod can be purchased here (740, -3355, -1530), for C$ 400,000.
Crimson Cavern is a sublocation of Desolate Deep, unlocked by completing Crimson Guard's quest.

To enter the Crimson Cavern, the player must open the red gate in Luminescent Cavern, which requires completing Crimson Guard's quest. To complete this quest, the player must bring them a Crimson Colossal Blue Dragon. It is recommended to catch a Colossal Blue Dragon using the Scarlet Spincaster Rod, as it has a 30% chance to apply the Crimson mutation needed to complete this quest.
After opening the gate, the player must swim through an underwater tunnel to reach the Crimson Cavern. The player must use diving gear to avoid drowning in the tunnel.
One area is located under the bridge at 19937, 636, 5709. A Conception Conch can be purchased here.
Cultist Lair can only be entered after receiving the Sea Traveler Note from the Sea Traveler's Quest.

Using the note, the player is directed to enter the Terrapin Hideaway. During Foggy Nights, a lever with a green outline can be found inside. Interacting with the lever will unlock the entrance to Cultist Lair permanently.
Much of the Desolate Deep has active sea mines, which explode and kill the player when touched. Many of the game's Diving Equipment are also purchased here.
A buoy located north of Sunstone Island marks the entrance to the Desolate Deep. (-790, 125, -3100)
The Advanced Diving Gear can be purchased here for C$ 15,000.
Frigid Cavern is the third area of the Northern Expedition located at 19737, 426, 5588. There is a camp in which the Summit Rod, Intermediate Oxygen Tank, and a Winter Cloak can be purchased.
At the end of the camp, a sheet of ice can be found blocking a cave. Using a Pickaxe, this ice can be broken to access a Lever.

Glacial Grotto is the fifth and final area of the Northern Expedition located at the very summit of the island. It features a large camp, where the Advanced Oxygen Tank, Advanced Glider and the Heaven's Rod can be purchased.
The entrance to Glacial Grotto's fishing area is located at 20000, 1042, 5717.

The Keepers Altar is an underground sublocation known for being the only place for enchanting Fishing Rods. After accepting Cole's deal of C$ 400 for a Token, or C$ 100,000 for unlimited access, he will allow players to use the elevator at the end of the Sovereignty Mines to descend to the Keepers Altar.
The Kings Rod can be purchased from the Keepers Altar for C$ 100,000 at 1380, -805, -300

The Living Garden is the second area reached upon navigating through the Toxic River; the player is required to use the Toxic-Proof Raft, obtained from completing Olivia's quest, to travel across the Toxic River. The Gas Mask is not required in this area. When entering the area for the first time, a cutscene will play.
Luminescent Cavern is a sublocation of the Desolate Deep, unlocked by placing three keystones in the Mysterious Crack.

Upon entering the right tunnel of the Desolate Deep, players will encounter a sublocation known as the Mysterious Crack. This area can be accessed by placing 3 keystones into the keystone pedestal. The specific keystones required differ for each player. However, the locations where they can be obtained are the same. There are 9 fixed keystone locations:

After placing the required keystones, the player can swim through a small passage revealed by the exploded cave crack. Heading down the Mysterious River will eventually lead to the cavern. The GPS coordinates of the Mysterious River are -1047, -321, -3322.
Additionally, 3 pedestals are situated near the entrance of the mineshaft, with each requiring a different item to be placed on them.
The 3 pedestals require the following items:
The Rough Geode
Radiant Crystal
The Cut Gem

It is where the tutorial quests occur and where most of the early-game Fishing Rods can be bought. Additionally, it is one of the few locations where fish can be Appraised, and one of the only places where Lanterns can be purchased.

The Nectar Den is the third area reached upon navigating through the Verdant Pocket. To stop the bees from stinging and killing the player, it is recommend to use the Pollinated Status Effect from the flowers in the Living Garden. The Gas Mask is not required in this area. When entering the area for the first time, a cutscene will play.
The primary means of transport throughout the Ocean is via Boats. While navigating without a boat is possible, it is not recommended.
At the end of the camp, a sheet of ice can be found blocking a cave. Using a Pickaxe, this ice can be broken to access a Lever.
Scoria Reach is a large area located Northeast of Grand Reef, this location features a large Volcano where the Temperature inside is extremely high.

The Depths is found past a large gate found at the bottom of Vertigos Dip. It can be opened with a Depths Key only after the player has fully completed Vertigo's bestiary. After meeting such requirements, talking to The Keeper next to the gate will open it.
The gate will remain open permanently after opening once — keys are no longer needed on each Depths visit as of a recent patch.
It cannot be opened for other players as it is client-sided. However, the Depths Key can still be traded.

The user can trade for the fish required in Vertigo's bestiary if the only goal is to unlock The Depths, however, it will not count towards percentage completion unless the user catches the fish themselves.
Shortly after traversing an obby consisting of floating platforms, The Depths can be entered through a crack in the wall.
Tidefall is a an extensive cave system beneath the Ocean, only accessible through the Underwater Opening.

Tidefall consists of six primary sublocations, with Underwater Opening as the entrance, and Tidefall as the center of the cave system; with each of the area excluding the entrance and the center itself being home to the different Fish Hunts.

The Toxic Grove is the first area reached upon navigating through the Toxic Cave. The player is required to keep the Gas Mask equipped in order to resist the effects of Poison. When entering the area for the first time, a cutscene will play.
Treasure Island is a Location that can be accessed by using the Traveler’s Whistle. It features a village built on golden hills, surrounded by shimmering, gilded waters.

The Veil of the Forsaken is the fifth sub-location of Mariana's Veil, located after completing a puzzle in Calm Zone. The area is home to the Scylla Hunts. It can be accessed after a series of puzzles, beginning in the Calm Zone.
Vertigo is a simple fantasy, hidden under our world! Vertigo, also known as The Abyss, is an underground location accessible via any Strange Whirlpool found in the Ocean.

The Volcanic Vents are the first distinct layer of the Cave System, with the entrance located at -2745, -2325, 865; the Submarine Upgrade in the Volcanic Vents must be unlocked before the player can travel further down, forcing the player to turn South-East and enter the horizontal tunnel to acquire the Submarine Upgrade. Being in the Volcanic Vents causes the player to accumulate heat, unless they are wearing any level of the Glimmerfin Suit or the Scoria Armor.

Within this cave is a Submariner and an Inn Keeper, as well as the upgrade station to acquire the Heat Upgrade for the Submarine, which is required to progress past the Volcanic Vents. Additionally, a portal back to Roslit Bay can be found at -3495, -2255, 3825, allowing the player to exit the cave system.
A lava obby can be accessed through a cave to the South, which features obstacles and lava geysers which will Burn the player, a Glider or Advanced Glider is recommended although not required.

At the end of the course is a pool of lava where the Inferno Hide, Blisterback Blenny, and Infernal Iguanafish may be caught for the Heat Upgrade; as well as the rest of the fish required for the Volcanic Vents Bestiary. Additionally, the Volcanic Rod can be purchased here (-3175, -2035, 4020), for C$ 150,000.
When the Gas Mask is equipped (by holding and clicking the item), the Gas Mask appears on the player's head and provides immunity to Poison.
The Gas Mask is purchasable next to Oliver for C$ 75,000 in Lost Jungle after completing 50% of Lost Jungle's Bestiary.
Upon equipping the Winter Cloak, the player's temperature meter will be set to 37°C and the temperature meter will no longer decrease until the Winter Cloak is removed.
The Winter Cloak can be obtained from the following locations:
Upon equipping the Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 2, the player's temperature meter will be set to 37°C and the temperature meter will no longer increase or decrease until the Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 2 is removed.
The Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 2 is unlocked from the Submarine Upgrade Station in the Challenger's Deep.
Upon equipping the Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 3, the player's temperature meter will be set to 37°C and the temperature meter will no longer increase or decrease until the Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 3 is removed.
The Glimmerfin Suit Lvl 3 is unlocked from the Submarine Upgrade Station in the Abyssal Zenith.
Movespeed The Scoria Armor is a suit equipment that prevents the player's temperature bar from increasing quickly. It is a useful item for fishing in the Scoria Reach.
Upon equipping the Scoria Armor, the player's temperature meter will be set to 37°C and the temperature meter will slowly increase until it reaches 44°C or until the Scoria Armor is removed.
The Scoria Armor is purchasable for C$ 75,000 in the Ashbrook Town after completing 20% of Scoria Reach's Bestiary.
The Toxic-Proof Raft is a Boat obtained from completing Olivia's quest.

It has a top speed of 15 S/ps, 40° of steering, and an acceleration of 0.1 S/ps. Additionally, it can accommodate 2 passengers and has a durability of 150, meaning it can travel on the passage between Toxic Grove and the Living Garden.
